About Me

Senior Graphic Designer with 8+ years of experience creating work that’s both beautiful and purposeful.

I specialize in branding, print production, and digital marketing design — helping businesses communicate their identity clearly and consistently. I’ve worked across industries from retail to healthcare, managing projects from concept to final deliverable, always with an eye for detail and a commitment to quality.
